headline: Senate Impeachment Court Orders Medical Review of Ailing DepEd Fund Witness
seoTitle: Impeachment Court Orders Medical Review of DepEd Witness | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News brief reports that the Senate Impeachment Court ordered an independent medical assessment of former DepEd disbursing officer Edward Fajarda.
deck: The court ordered an independent assessment after the former DepEd disbursing officer sought to be excused on medical grounds.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News midday brief reports that the Senate Impeachment Court ordered an independent government medical evaluation of former DepEd Special Disbursing Officer Edward Fajarda after his counsel sought to excuse him from testimony on health grounds.
The brief says the assessment is intended to help the court determine whether testimony can proceed later or through an alternative format if medically appropriate.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Fajarda is being sought as a witness in proceedings examining confidential-fund disbursements during Vice President Sara Duterte's tenure as education secretary. Allegations aired in an impeachment proceeding remain allegations unless established through the court process.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The medical determination affects both witness welfare and the court's ability to develop a complete evidentiary record without treating an asserted health condition as either automatically disqualifying or automatically irrelevant.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch the Senate Impeachment Court for the medical report, any ruling on testimony format and the next witness schedule.
